name: The r/visualnovels Visual Novel 2: Revenge of the Devtalkers
source:
After the first edition's success, here comes the next (although unofficial) entry in the Our VNs series: Revenge of the Devtalkers.

Honestly don't expect this to be good.

[From [url=https://ssparks.itch.io/our-vns-2-devtalkers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:

说实话，别指望它会很好。
